prompt.project_info: Create a high-end beauty and fashion double-exposure composition on a deep dark-red studio gradient.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with sleek dark hair pulled back, nude-glow skin, smoky eyes, defined lashes, glossy nude lips, fitted black midi cocktail dress with secure coverage and thin straps, black heels and statement earrings; foreground standing with one hand on hip and background close-up softly gazing toward camera.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 centered double exposure: large soft-focus beauty close-up behind a full-body standing figure, deep dark-red gradient fading to near-black, no typography or logos.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused frontal beauty light, subtle warm rim separating the subject, luxury glam campaign mood, clean layered depth.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm for close-up, 50mm for full body, shallow background focus and moderate foreground focus, subtle analog grain, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-end 4:5 beauty editorial double exposure of a clearly adult fictional woman with sleek dark hair, nude-glow skin, smoky eyes, glossy nude lips, fitted black midi cocktail dress with secure coverage, black heels and statement earrings; large soft-focus close-up behind a centered full-body standing pose with one hand on hip, deep dark-red gradient to near-black, soft diffused beauty light, warm rim, 85mm and 50mm lens character, subtle analog grain, no text or logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent dress, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, over-smoothed, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed
